question: What is the name of the SpaceX mission that launched a private astronaut crew to orbit Earth from pole to pole?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fram2.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **SpaceX launched a private astronaut crew on the Fram2 mission, a unique polar-orbiting mission.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The mission, named Fram2, was led by Chun Wang, a Maltese investor and cryptocurrency entrepreneur.**
 
• **Wang and three other private astronauts launched aboard SpaceX’s Crew Dragon capsule from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center.**
 
• **The mission marked a novel trajectory, where the astronauts orbited Earth from pole to pole, a path previously untraveled by humans.**
 
• **During the mission, the astronauts participated in 22 research experiments focused on the effects of spaceflight on the human body.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Crew Dragon__

 __
 
• SpaceX’s Crew Dragon is a reusable spacecraft developed to carry astronauts to the International Space Station (ISS).
 
 
 
• Falcon 9__
 
 
• Falcon 9 is a two-stage rocket developed by SpaceX to carry payloads into orbit and is used for launching Crew Dragon missions.
